items.title: Gerald "Tadpole" Joseph Interview, 1969-06-10
items.q: Well, you have, uh, you studied for how many years with Cazier? ... Oh, I would say, uh, let me see, it's, uh, let me try and make that a little bit of a thing. Well, I'd say about six years.

ctx.x: Uh, well, I've done this on my own. On my own, I used to read a few books on harmony and try to write little tunes and everything. As far as the construction of different scales and everything, uh, this I know. But, uh, they tackled something real hard, uh, I can tell you, uh, it would be hard on me because, uh, I really haven't got the real depth of it, uh, as far as writing it down on paper. But, uh, I can perform it as far as my own is concerned. There's no doubt about it.
Well, you have, uh, you studied for how many years with Cazier?
Oh, I would say, uh, let me see, it's, uh, let me try and make that a little bit of a thing. Well, I'd say about six years.
